desc: Read N, K and array A from stdin.
Precompute binomial coefficients C(K, t) modulo MOD.
Initialize cur[0..K] with cur[0]=1 (for P_0=0) and others 0; initialize V[0..K]=0.
Iterate over each element a in A: update prefix sum P, compute powers p^0..p^K, update V[t] += p^t * cur[K-t] for all t, then update cur[m] += p^m for all m.
After loop, compute answer = sum_{t=0..K} (-1)^{K-t} * C[t] * V[t] mod MOD.
